scenarios.context: Two neighbors meet for the first time.

speakerA.en: Hello! I'm Sara. I live in 5B.
Nice to meet you, Ali. Are you new here?
Welcome! I'm happy to meet you.

speakerB.en: Hi Sara! I'm Ali. Nice to meet you.
Yes, I am. I live in 6B.

scenarios.context: A new employee meets a coworker.

speakerA.en: Good morning! I'm Mina. I'm new.
Thank you. Where is my desk?

speakerB.en: Good morning, Mina. I'm David. Welcome!
It's here. This is your desk.

scenarios.context: Two students meet on the first day.

speakerA.en: Hello! I'm Lina. I'm from Spain.

speakerB.en: Hi Lina! I'm Omar. I'm from Egypt.
Nice to meet you too. Are you a student?
Yes, I am. I like English.

scenarios.context: Two guests talk at a party.

speakerA.en: Hi! I'm Tom. What's your name?
Nice to meet you, Nora. Do you know Anna?

speakerB.en: Hi Tom. My name is Nora.

scenarios.context: Two people check their sound at the start of a video class.

speakerA.en: Yes, I can hear you. Can you hear me?
